title: Questionnaire sur les troubles de l'humeur (MDQ)
formula:
The MDQ is determined by the following three sections. Please select the response that best reflects the patient’s answer:

| Variable | Score | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Section 1. Has there ever been a period of time when you were not your usual self and… | | |
| …you felt so good or so hyper that other people thought you were not your normal self or you were so hyper that you got into trouble? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| ...you were so irritable that you shouted at people or started fights or arguments? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| ...you felt much more self-confident than usual? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| ...you got much less sleep than usual and found you didn’t really miss it? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| ...you were much more talkative or spoke faster than usual? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| ...thoughts raced through your head or you couldn’t slow your mind down? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| ...you were so easily distracted by things around you that you had trouble concentrating or staying on track? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| ...you had much more energy than usual? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| ...you were much more active or did many more things than usual? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| ...you were much more social or outgoing than usual, for example, you telephoned friends in the middle of the night? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| ...you were much more interested in sex than usual? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| ...you did things that were unusual for you or that other people might have thought were excessive, foolish, or risky? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| ...spending money got you or your family into trouble? | No | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | |
| Section 2. If the patient answered YES to more than one of the above, did several of these occur during the same period of time? | No | |
| Yes | | |
| Section 3. Based on the patient’s response, how much of a problem did these cause, such as difficulty working or problems with family, finances, legal matters, arguments, or fights? | No problem | |
| Minor problem | | |
| Moderate problem | | |
| Serious problem | | |

how_to_use.why:
- A brief screening instrument to identify possible bipolar spectrum disorder (primarily bipolar I disorder) using symptom and functional impairment data.
- Results can prompt further diagnostic evaluation, helping to reduce delays to appropriate diagnosis and treatment.
how_to_use.when:
- À utiliser chez les patients se présentant en ambulatoire avec des symptômes de l’humeur pour dépister un trouble bipolaire.
- Envisager un dépistage chez les patients présentant des symptômes dépressifs afin de rechercher un trouble bipolaire sous-jacent avant d’instaurer un traitement antidépresseur.
- Peut être administré par le clinicien ou en auto-administration.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Sensitivity and specificity vary by clinical setting:

 - In psychiatric outpatient populations from the derivation study, the tool demonstrated good sensitivity (0.73) and very good specificity (0.90) at a cutoff of 7.
 - In primary care and general population settings during validation studies, sensitivity dropped substantially (approximately 0.28–0.43) while specificity remained high (approximately 0.95–0.97).
- Has lower sensitivity for bipolar II disorder than for bipolar I; maintain diagnostic suspicion even with a negative screen in patients with features suggestive of hypomania.
- Not intended as a diagnostic tool and should not be used to establish a diagnosis of bipolar disorder.
- Cannot reliably distinguish between bipolar disorder and conditions with overlapping symptoms (e.g., borderline personality disorder, complex trauma, ADHD).

next_steps.advice: Interpréter les résultats dans le contexte du tableau clinique complet, y compris les antécédents longitudinaux, la réponse aux traitements antérieurs et les antécédents familiaux de trouble bipolaire.
next_steps.management:
- Un dépistage positif doit conduire à une évaluation clinique formelle, mais ne permet pas d’établir le diagnostic.
- Un dépistage négatif n’exclut pas un trouble bipolaire, en particulier un trouble bipolaire de type II ; si la suspicion clinique persiste, envisager une orientation pour une évaluation diagnostique structurée.

more_info: A **positive screen** for bipolar spectrum disorder was defined as 7 or more symptoms in Section 1, “Yes” in Section 2, and a problem severity of “moderate” or “serious” in Section 3.
short_description: Dépistage du trouble du spectre bipolaire.
medium_description: Screens pour bipolar spectrum disorder dans psychiatric outpatients.
